snippet.title: Teemo Jump! Trailer
snippet.description:
Teemo Jump! brings a fresh twist to the classic gameplay of Doodle Jump by featuring one of the most beloved champions from League of Legends—Teemo! In this game, players navigate Teemo through a series of platforms, aiming to reach new heights while encountering charming nods to his mischievous persona. With engaging visuals inspired by the League of Legends universe, Teemo Jump combines nostalgia with creativity, offering both LoL fans and casual gamers a fun, addictive experience.


Released:
2021-5-25

Play the game: geldregen.itch.io/teemo-jump
